integrity: The claimed theorem is proved analytically from the exact Bregman proximal-gradient update and the objective-infimum guarantee of arXiv:2508.01353; numerical replay is used only as a consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The proof is restricted to a collinear invariant ray of a radial least-squares problem.
The asymptotic rate is expressed in cumulative adaptive step mass, not directly in iteration count.
Full text of arXiv:2608.05536 was unavailable during the literature comparison; only its abstract was inspected.
title: Exact cumulative-step boundary law for B-adaPG on an invariant Hellinger ray
